summary: When a finally block completes normally, preserve the prior try/catch completion including return or throw.

target.notes: Native only after analysis proves the finally body cannot produce throw/return/break/continue and JS thrown values already use the JsException wrapper representation.

semantics.prior_completion: preserved when finally completion is normal
semantics.throw: wrapped JS throw continues after finally

caveats: C# forbids control leaving a finally clause, while JavaScript permits abrupt completion from finally.
